worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.summary: Leap above the target and press down with your whole body: this move counts as both Fighting and Flying, scales with your own weight, slams an airborne target toward the ground with a native hurt impulse, and knocks a grounded one aside. Target an entity or an air/ground point.
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.use.0: Drop from above onto an airborne target
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.use.1: Crush a tough adjacent target with your weight
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.use.2: Leap over a small crowd onto the back line
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.descriptio: The press deals about %1$s damage; it counts as Fighting and Flying, a Flying user also gets its own STAB, and an airborne target takes x1.2; defence and criticals settle at impact.

From your own current position it leaps about %1$s blocks (rising %2$s blocks per tick, shortened by a real ceiling), allows one re-aim at the top and locks the dive endpoint, then dives at %3$s blocks per tick; an airborne target therefore gets one chance to sidestep.

The press radius is %1$s blocks; only a real contact with an enemy body settles the press, knocking the target %2$s blocks aside and slamming an airborne one toward the ground. Hitting a wall or empty air only scuffs dust and never falls back to the original target.
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.dive.on: High dive on: leaps +1.2 blocks higher, press about x1.12, dives faster, but slower to start and longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.dive.off: High dive off (low quick press): presses low, about x0.92 damage, but faster to recover and shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.timing: Castable on a target within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s s prepare it spends %4$s PP; it recovers for %3$s s and its cooldown starts on commit for %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.growth.0: At level %1$s the press power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.growth.1: At level %1$s the press power rises to %2$s and the leap height to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.flyingpress.preference: On: leaps +1.2 blocks higher, press about x1.12 and dives faster, but +2 ticks to start and +8 cooldown, best against airborne and tough targets. Off (low quick press): presses low for about x0.92, faster to recover.
The companion leaps only when a target is this close; lower presses only up close, higher chases a bit first.
On: flying or airborne targets are strongly preferred, since pressing them from above is the point; off: grounded and airborne are equal.
